description.en: Plugin-authoring skill for DeepSeek Harness: the distilled anatomy, client-UI recipe, slots, locale, theme tokens, install steps, gotchas, and validation checklist for building and publishing new DSH plugins.
DSH 网页版桌面宠物「肥鲸」——蓝发鲸鱼娘，固定在 harness 页面右下角：会眨眼、能拖拽、点击可聊天，支持语音对话、念诗说书、饭点提醒。

Live DeepSeek API token price bar for the web GUI: peak/off-peak tariff, UTC + local (Quebec) clocks, countdown to the next tariff change, and a daily self-verification against the official DeepSeek pricing page.
鱼搭子 · DSH 这半边：桌面小挂件说的话送进你绑定的会话，她的回话再递回挂件。挂件是独立程序，这里只负责接线。
DSH plugin bundle

Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin, no API key.
Cordis plugin: image/video backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.

把 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）接到微信：在微信里直接和本机 Agent 对话，一轮一条完整回答，输入状态与进度提示，图片文件双向收发。WeChat (iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness — chat with your local DSH agent from WeChat.

Route delegated subagents and Agent Teams over free-tier models: choose a pool of approved free routes once, and every child request fails over to the next free model with a persistent ledger of quota, rate-limit and timeout parks.
独立模型数据源与官方清单发现，基于证据规划 pi-ai 补缺、待确认与宽限移除；可恢复目录事务、内容与修订所有权校验，附 provider 设置及监控。

Full-interface whale skin pack for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: layered wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner mascot that reacts to agent state, ambient particles, and an installable third-party skin-pack format.
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.
Engineering bundle: Studio 5000 L5X, FactoryTalk View ME, FactoryTalk Optix, MotionWorks IEC, DXF/DWG drawing previews and RSLogix 500/5 migration - one install, one row per toolchain.
A2A protocol for DSH: expose a DSH Session as a standard A2A agent, call remote A2A agents, and run invite-only collaboration groups where a group is itself an A2A agent behind a gateway.

Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.

VOD user-voice collection tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Thin shell over the VOD external HTTP API — mirrors vod-devkit (MCP) collect semantics.

Monitor BI 报表工作室:左侧导航栏独立入口,点进去就是 Harness 原生对话,但该房间只做 Monitor BI 报表(上下文干净、不与日常对话混杂)。自带零安装 CLI 工具链、操作手册、模板、数据字典;首次使用自动询问连接信息。A clean, sidebar-entry BI-only room for DeepSeek Harness with bundled tools, manual, templates and dictionary.

Monitor 数据搬运工作室:左侧导航独立入口,把一个 Monitor 公司的数据(主数据/BOM/未结订单/库存快照/附加字段)经官方 API 搬进另一个 Monitor 系统,跨版本不动表结构/角色/权限。自带进程内引擎(源库直读+目标API写入)与操作手册。A sidebar-entry data transfer studio for DeepSeek Harness: moves one Monitor company into another via official APIs only.

dsh-Fang (瓮城) — mother/fork plugin development environment for DeepSeek Harness: one readonly mother, a disposable child dsh-Web per task.
